description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that provides UI and control logic for scheduling, canceling, and managing jobs using Android's JobScheduler API. It handles user input for job parameters, interacts with the JobScheduler system service to schedule/cancel jobs, and communicates with a background service (MyJobService) via Messenger for job status updates.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that facilitates scheduling and managing jobs via JobScheduler, providing user interface controls and messaging with a background service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and prepares the message handler.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts the service and sets up communication via Messenger.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Stops the background service when activity is stopped.

methods.name: scheduleJob
methods.description: Builds and schedules a job based on user input parameters.

methods.name: finishJob
methods.description: Cancels the most recent pending job.
